hook.name: RefractHook
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that acts as the sole market maker for the REFRACT (RFR) token using a linear bonding curve. ETH buys release tokens from the hook's inventory; RFR sells are paid from the ETH reserve and sold tokens are queued for permanent burn, making the token supply monotonically deflationary. Liquidity provision by external LPs is disabled.
